Write me a 3 paragraph story about a tiger who learns to cook biryani
5:32 AM

In the hills of Ranthambore lived a tigress named Meera who had grown bored of raw dinners. One winter afternoon a picnic party left behind a half-eaten handi, and a single lick of that golden, fragrant rice changed her life. She sat by the empty pot till sunset, sniffing cardamom and cloves, and promised herself she would cook one of her own.

Learning was messy. She dropped the rice in the river, mistook a beehive for a spice jar, and once left the pot on the fire so long that the smoke brought the whole forest running. A wise old langur named Bholu, who had spent years watching a dhaba kitchen from a rooftop, finally took pity on her. He taught her to soak the rice, brown the onions slowly, and above all to keep the lid shut and wait.

On the night of the full moon, Meera lifted the lid and steam rose like a soft cloud over the clearing. Deer, peacocks and even the grumpy sloth bear lined up with leaf plates, and for once nobody was afraid of the tiger. From then on, every full moon was biryani night in the jungle, and Meera learnt that patience is the best spice of all. 🐯

5:34 AM

Here are 5 tips to sleep better:

Go to bed and wake up at the same time every day, even on weekends.
Keep your phone and other screens away for 30 to 60 minutes before bed.
Skip tea and coffee after 2:00 PM.
Keep your room cool, dark and quiet.
Eat a light dinner at least 2 hours before you sleep.
